name: Athletics
description: Welcome to the Athletics Club of IIT Indore, where we promote physical fitness and healthy competition through various athletic activities. Our club provides a platform for students who are interested in running, jumping, throwing, or any other athletic endeavor to come together and pursue their passion. We aim to encourage our members to push their limits, develop their skills, and foster teamwork and sportsmanship. Whether you're a seasoned athlete or just starting out, the Athletics Club of IIT Indore has something for everyone. Join us today to explore your potential and unleash your inner athlete!

name: Badminton
description: The badminton club of our institute is a student-run group dedicated to promote and facilitate the sport of badminton among students. The club offers opportunities for players of all skill levels to come together, play, and compete in a friendly and supportive environment. The club typically organises regular training sessions and tournaments and provides access to equipment and facilities for the club members to practice and play. It also collaborates with other institutes to participate in intercollege competitions and events such as Inter IIT and Ranbhoomi.

name: Basketball
description: Basketball Club is one of the prominent sports club in IIT Indore. Both Girls and Boys teams are formed and they actively participate in the events conducted by the club. Club always welcomes new beginners and encourages talent.

name: Cricket
description: IIT Indore facilitates the prospect of having its own cricket club. Our main focus is provide a professional level facilities to the student and have a good culture of cricket among them. To promote the same we take part in various tournaments, matches with professional clubs. Also we have a quality coaching facility which nourish the talent of the individual. Overall one can have a good exposure and experience of playing cricket with us.

name: Chess
description: The primary objective in chess is to checkmate your opponent's King. When a King cannot avoid capture then it is checkmated and the game is immediately over. The game is drawn when the player to move has no legal move and his king is not in check. The game is said to end in 'stalemate'.

name: Football
description: Football Club is a very popular sports club at IIT Indore. The club is headed by Harsh Wardhan and is Coached by Mr. Vishal Pillai, an excellent football player and educator. The football club receives active participation from UG, PG, PhD students and Institute Faculty and Staff also. The Men's team actively participates in the events around Indore. The Club always welcomes new beginners and encourages talent.

name: Hockey
description: The Hockey Club is one of the most active sports clubs at IIT Indore, committed to nurturing talent and fostering a competitive spirit among students. Through structured training, practice matches, and participation in inter-college tournaments, the club provides a platform for players to enhance their technical skills, physical fitness, and teamwork. The club welcomes enthusiasts of all skill levels and strives to uphold the values of dedication, discipline, and sportsmanship.

name: Tennis
description: The objective of our club is to develop the players' stamina, speed, agility and flexibility. The trainings should also help the players develop their racket reaction and coordination. It is also very important to teach the players on the dynamic balance between the body, ball and the racket.

name: Table Tennis
description: Welcome to the Table Tennis Club of IIT Indore, where we bring together the best players from our institute to promote and develop the sport of table tennis. To ensure that our members have the best possible experience, we induct players who demonstrate exceptional talent, dedication, and sportsmanship. We offer a range of activities and events, including friendly matches, tournaments, and coaching sessions.

name: Volleyball
description: The club provides knowledge, understanding, and appreciation to the game of volleyball. It also develops satisfactory competency in basic skills such as body posture, forearm pass, serve and serve reception, overhead pass, attack, block, and game situational strategies.

name: Gym
description: Purpose of the gym is to help you learn new exercises, techniques and training methods to meet your weight-loss, muscle building, heart health or sports performance goals.

name: Yoga
description: Aims and objectives of Yoga Club: To enable the student to have good health, to practice mental hygiene, to possess emotional stability, to integrate moral values, and to attain higher level of consciousness.

name: Cycling
description: The Cycling Club at IIT Indore brings together cycling enthusiasts who share a passion for fitness, exploration, and outdoor adventure. The club organizes regular rides, endurance challenges and awareness campaigns. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced cyclist, the club provides a platform to improve your skills, stay active, and enjoy the thrill of cycling with a vibrant community.

name: Weight Lifting
description: The Weightlifting Club at IIT Indore empowers students to develop strength, endurance, and self-discipline through structured training and competitive participation. Open to all fitness enthusiasts, the club promotes a healthy lifestyle while helping members achieve their personal and athletic goals.
